# testdata/series — synthetic workload fixtures (WO-02)

One JSON file per signal pattern, generated by `tools/synth` from the explicit workloads in
`tools/synth/scenarios/fleet-small.yaml` (cluster `synth-a`, 14 days ending 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z,
5-minute buckets). They are meant for recommender table tests (WO-04) that should not need
VictoriaMetrics.

Regenerate after changing the generator or the scenario:

```bash
make synth-fixtures          # go run ./tools/synth fixtures --out testdata/series
go test ./tools/synth/...    # TestFixturesUpToDate fails if the files are stale
```

## Files

| File | Pattern | Expectation (`expect`) |
|---|---|---|
| `synth-flat-0.json` | flat CPU and memory, well below requests | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |
| `synth-diurnal-0.json` | daily cycle (peak 12:00 UTC) | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |
| `synth-weekly-0.json` | daily cycle plus weekend dip (×0.4) | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |
| `synth-spiky-0.json` | rare 5-minute ×5 bursts | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |
| `synth-leak-0.json` | memory leak, OOMKilled at the limit ~every 12h | memory ↑, `oom-killed` |
| `synth-step-0.json` | release 4 days before the end triples CPU | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |
| `synth-sparse-0.json` | CronJob, 10-minute run every hour | `short-lived` |
| `synth-throttled-0.json` | CPU demand above a 500m limit at the daily peak | cpu ↑, `throttled` |
| `synth-hpa-0.json` | CPU-utilization HPA (2–8 replicas, target 70%) | `hpa-coupled` |
| `synth-jvm-0.json` | JVM: startup CPU spike, GC sawtooth memory near the limit, 2 rollouts | cpu ↓, memory keep |
| `synth-sidecar-0.json` | app + `envoy` sidecar | `sidecar` |
| `synth-new-0.json` | created 36h before the end | `low-confidence` |
| `synth-restarting-0.json` | crash (reason `Error`) every ~8h | `restarting` |
| `synth-daemon-0.json` | DaemonSet, one pod per node | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |
| `synth-ledger-store-0.json` | StatefulSet, 3 replicas, weekly pattern | cpu ↓, memory ↓ |

`expect.cpu` / `expect.memory` are `decrease`, `keep` (within roughly ±25%), `increase` or `any`;
`expect.riskFlags` lists flags a correct recommender must raise (it may raise more, e.g.
`restarting` next to `oom-killed`). They are the ground truth from the scenario file.

## Schema (`schemaVersion: 1`)

Load with `synth.LoadFixture(path)` (`github.com/kerf-dev/kerf/tools/synth/synth`),
which maps `null` to `NaN`.

```jsonc
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "cluster": "synth-a", "namespace": "patterns", "workloadKind": "Deployment", "workload": "synth-leak-0",
  "pattern": "leak",                       // dominant signal pattern
  "expect": {"cpu": "decrease", "memory": "increase", "riskFlags": ["oom-killed"]},
  "hpa": {"min": 2, "max": 8, "metric": "cpu", "target": 70},   // only for HPA workloads
  "start": 1789603200,                     // unix seconds of bucket 0
  "step": 300,                             // bucket width, seconds
  "points": 4032,                          // length of every array below
  "replicas": [2, 2, ...],                 // desired replicas (HPA: current); CronJob: running pods
  "containers": [{
    "name": "app", "image": "...", "sidecar": false, "init": false,
    "requests": {"cpu": 0.25, "memory": 536870912},   // cores, bytes; missing key = unset
    "limits":   {"memory": 536870912},
    "cpu":    {"max": [...], "avg": [...]},  // per pod: mean cores in the bucket (= rate over 5m); max/avg across pods
    "memory": {"max": [...], "avg": [...]},  // per pod: max working-set bytes in the bucket; max/avg across pods
    "throttleRatio": [...],                  // throttled/total CFS periods, max across pods (only with a CPU limit)
    "restarts": 51, "oomKills": 51           // totals over the window
  }]
}
```

`null` means no pod was running in that bucket (before creation, between CronJob runs).
Init containers appear with `"init": true` and carry requests/limits only.

For tests that need raw Prometheus series instead, generate them in-process:

```go
sc, _ := synth.LoadScenario("tools/synth/scenarios/fleet-small.yaml")
g, _ := synth.New(sc, synth.Options{End: synth.FixtureEnd, Days: 14, Clusters: []string{"synth-a"}})
g.Each(4, func(wt *synth.WorkloadTrace) error {
    return g.EmitWorkload(wt, func(s *synth.Series) error { /* s.Labels, s.Value(k) at g.Timeline.Ms(s.Start+k) */ return nil })
})
```
